# Deterministic Fake Embedding for Testing

An internal fake embedder is provided that deterministically generates 8-dimensional vectors from content hashes of the input texts. This enables reliable tests of embedding-dependent code without requiring network or external dependencies, and without guaranteeing geometric similarity.
